policy: Recipes describe proven composition, behavior, acceptance criteria, and source pointers. They are not free-form JSX templates and do not add component APIs.

recipes.name: 邮箱字段校验
behavior: On blur, map native typeMismatch to aria-invalid and Field data-invalid.
Show inline FieldError instead of a browser validation popup.
acceptance: FieldError announces the format error inline.
No call-site border/color override is used.
forbidden: Do not add an email-validation Button.
Do not simulate validation with a custom regex when native validity covers the format.
Do not replace FieldError with a floating browser popup.

symbols: 请输入有效的邮箱地址。

recipes.name: 可清除搜索输入
recipes.composition: InputGroup + Input(type=search) + one SearchIcon affix + conditional clear InputAction
behavior: Place SearchIcon at either start or end, never both.
Show a labelled clear action only when a query exists.
An attached primary search action is optional and uses InputAction variant=primary.
acceptance: SearchIcon is rendered in one structural slot only.
Clear action has an accessible name.
The browser WebKit search clear affordance is not duplicated.
forbidden: Do not add a search prop to Input.
Do not absolutely position a search icon or override Input padding.
Do not configure clear as a separate business capability.

recipes.name: 带范围的全局搜索
recipes.composition: TopBar + TopBarSearch(value, onValueChange, scope, scopes, onScopeChange)
behavior: Keep query and scope controlled by the page.
When scopes are omitted, TopBarSearch degrades to a plain global search input.
Search navigation and request logic remain in the page, not inside TopBar.
acceptance: TopBarSearch receives controlled value and onValueChange.
Scope selection uses scopes + scope + onScopeChange together.
Icon actions retain accessible labels and tooltips.
forbidden: Do not put global scope props on basic Input.
Do not bury search routing inside TopBar.
Do not recreate the top bar with raw divs.

recipes.name: 日期范围筛选
behavior: Keep start and end as separate date values.
Each picker may be controlled or uncontrolled using the DatePicker API.
Validation uses Field + aria-invalid + FieldError when needed.
acceptance: Two DatePicker instances are used for a range.
Start and end dates are not concatenated into one string value.
Each picker retains its calendar trigger and accessible error state.
forbidden: Do not add a date prop or calendar icon business semantics to base Input.
Do not invent a range string API on DatePicker.
Do not override invalid borders at the call site.
